summary.short: Chile's Fintec Law 21.521 requires crowdfunding, alternative trading, brokerage, order-routing, custody and advisory providers to register with the CMF and obtain authorization, and creates an open finance regime for consent-based data sharing and payment initiation. Titles II and III apply from CMF rules.
summary.long: Law 21.521 (Fintec) is supervised by the CMF. Title II requires providers of crowdfunding platforms, alternative trading systems, brokerage, order routing, custody and credit or investment advice to register and obtain prior authorization for each service, meet guarantee, minimum equity, governance and cybersecurity requirements, and inform clients. Registration is refused to persons with specified prior sanctions and can be cancelled for serious infractions (Art. 14). Title III creates an open finance system in which banks and card issuers must provide consented client data through standardized interfaces, with payment initiation providers able to initiate payments with client consent; data-access fees are limited to incremental costs and clients cannot be charged for these services. Consent is revocable at any time. The CMF may order suspensions and sanction breaches under DL 3.538. Title IV requires product suitability and non-misleading advertising. Title V amends banking, securities, fund management, insurance, anti-money laundering and Law 20.009 fraud rules; algorithms automating certain fund functions must demonstrate suitability. Titles II and III apply from CMF rules; existing providers have 12 months to register and CMF rules are due within 18 months.

Intermediación de instrumentos financieros: servicio en virtud del cual se realizan actividades de compra o venta de instrumentos financieros para terceros

Proyecto de inversión: aquella iniciativa que tiene por finalidad la generación de intereses, utilidades o contraprestaciones pecuniarias

obligations.summary: Information-based service providers and payment initiation providers must use authentication mechanisms and obtain the client's prior and explicit consent before consulting information or initiating payments; for information requests the consent must be free, informed, express and specific.

evidence.quote: deberán adoptar mecanismos de autentificación del Cliente y obtener su consentimiento previo y explícito

obligations.summary: The client may revoke consent at any time.

evidence.quote: Éste podrá revocar en cualquier momento el consentimiento otorgado

obligations.summary: After consent is revoked, the information-based service provider or payment initiation provider may not continue using the consent for new information queries or new payment orders.

evidence.quote: estará prohibido al Proveedor de Servicios basados en Información

obligations.summary: Information provider institutions must implement mechanisms to authenticate information-based service providers and payment initiation providers and verify their registration with the Commission.

evidence.quote: deberán implementar mecanismos para la autenticación de los Proveedores de Servicios basados en Información

obligations.summary: Participants are responsible for the integrity, availability, security and confidentiality of data in each transaction and for client privacy; providers must use data only within the client's authorisation and answer to clients for unauthorised access or loss of data.

evidence.quote: serán responsables de resguardar la integridad, disponibilidad, seguridad y confidencialidad de los datos

obligations.summary: Information-based service providers and payment initiation providers must stop accessing information and initiating payments as soon as consent is withdrawn or expires, or when vulnerabilities put client data at risk, and in that case notify the client, the Commission and the information provider.
obligations.conditional_on: Consent withdrawn, expired, or vulnerability identified

evidence.quote: deberán interrumpir el acceso de información y la realización de nuevas órdenes de pago tan pronto el Cliente retire su consentimiento

obligations.summary: Participants must handle client queries and complaints about exchanged data and services through client service mechanisms.

evidence.quote: deberán disponer de mecanismos de atención de Clientes

obligations.summary: Information provider institutions may not charge information-based service providers for communicating client data through the Open Finance interfaces, except reimbursement of incremental direct costs above a volume threshold set by the Commission.

evidence.quote: no podrán efectuar cobros a los Proveedores de Servicios basados en Información

obligations.summary: Information provider and account provider institutions may not impose restrictions, limitations or obstacles on access by authorised service providers, nor discriminate against their requests relative to the client's own direct transactions.

evidence.quote: no podrán establecer restricciones, limitaciones u obstáculos para el intercambio de información

obligations.summary: The Commission must issue the regulation and instructions needed for the Open Finance System and supervise compliance by the participating institutions.

evidence.quote: Corresponderá a la Comisión dictar la regulación e instrucciones necesarias

obligations.summary: Before issuing Open Finance rules, the Commission must carry out public consultation and regulatory impact assessment and request a report from the Fiscalía Nacional Económica.

evidence.quote: se deberán llevar a cabo los trámites de consulta pública y evaluación de impacto regulatorio

obligations.summary: Covered providers and listed banks and institutions must adopt policies, procedures and controls to avoid offering products that do not match client needs, expectations and risk tolerance; they may request client information and must inform clients of product characteristics and risks.

evidence.quote: deberán adoptar políticas, procedimientos y controles tendientes a evitar que se ofrezcan productos que no sean acorde

obligations.summary: Information, advertising or promotion of financial products may not contain statements or representations that may mislead the public about nature, prices, returns or other characteristics of the products or providers.

evidence.quote: no podrá contener declaraciones, alusiones o representaciones que puedan inducir a error

obligations.summary: Banks offering current accounts must set public, objective and non-discriminatory conditions for access to those accounts by regulated providers, card issuers and other institutions the Commission designates.

evidence.quote: deberán establecer las condiciones públicas, objetivas y no discriminatorias

obligations.summary: A bank that refuses, suspends or closes a current account for an institution must communicate the decision promptly and state the justified reasons, linked to the specific risks or the applicant's non-compliance with the general conditions.
obligations.conditional_on: Refusal, suspension or closure of the account

evidence.quote: deberá comunicar dicha decisión a la mayor brevedad, y por causa justificada

obligations.summary: As amended into Ley 20.950 Art. 5, non-bank issuers of prepaid payment means may use money received from the public only for payments for use of those means, executing transfers instructed by the holder, charges, or reimbursement.

evidence.quote: solamente podrá destinarse a efectuar los pagos correspondientes a la utilización de dichos medios

obligations.summary: As inserted into Ley 19.913 Art. 3, registered providers of crowdfunding, alternative transaction systems, custody, intermediation and payment initiation services must report to the UAF (anti-money-laundering unit) under the same obligations as the listed entities.

evidence.provision: Art. 36, numeral 2 (inserting into Ley 19.913, Art. 3, inciso 1)
evidence.quote: quienes estén inscritos en el Registro de Prestadores de Servicios Financieros y en el Registro de Proveedores de Servicios de Iniciación de Pagos

obligations.summary: As inserted into Ley 20.009 Art. 4, where a payment initiated through a payment initiation provider is disputed, the emitter must prove that the operation was authorised and recorded, and the provider must prove this within its competence.
obligations.conditional_on: Disputed electronic payment initiated through a payment initiation provider

evidence.provision: Art. 38, numeral 1 (replacing Ley 20.009, Art. 4, inciso quinto)
evidence.quote: corresponderá al emisor probar que ella fue autorizada por el usuario y que se encuentra registrada a su nombre

obligations.summary: As replaced in Ley 20.009 Art. 6, card issuers, operators, merchants and other entities involved in electronic payments, including payment initiation providers, must adopt security measures to prevent the listed offences and protect data privacy; issuers must have transaction monitoring, alert procedures and fraud limits.

evidence.quote: deberán adoptar las medidas de seguridad necesarias para prevenir la comisión de los ilícitos

obligations.summary: As inserted into Ley 21.236 Art. 30, communications between providers in a financial portability process must take place through the remote, automated interfaces of participants in the Open Finance System.
obligations.conditional_on: Providers are participants in the Open Finance System

evidence.provision: Art. 39 (inserting into Ley 21.236, Art. 30, inciso final)
evidence.quote: deberán realizarse a través de las interfaces de acceso remoto y automatizado

obligations.summary: As inserted into DFL 251 Art. 3, the Commission must set by general rule the minimum conditions that insurers and insurance intermediaries must meet for public service, including in offices and other channels.

evidence.provision: Art. 40, numeral 1 (inserting DFL 251, Art. 3, literal n))
evidence.quote: Establecer, mediante norma de carácter general, las condiciones mínimas que deberán cumplir las compañías de seguros

obligations.summary: As inserted into Ley 18.876 Art. 20, depositary and custody entities must meet corporate governance and risk management requirements set by the Commission by general rule.

evidence.provision: Art. 41, numeral 2 (inserting Ley 18.876, Art. 20, literal i))
evidence.quote: Cumplir con las exigencias de gobierno corporativo y gestión de riesgos que determine la Comisión mediante norma de carácter general.

obligations.summary: As inserted into DL 3.538 Art. 5 numeral 36, the Commission must set by general rule the minimum conditions that supervised institutions must meet for public service, including in offices and other channels.

evidence.quote: Establecer, mediante norma de carácter general, las condiciones mínimas que deberán cumplir las instituciones fiscalizadas en materia de atención al público

obligations.summary: Persons providing services under Title II that must be registered must apply for registration and authorisation within twelve months from the entry into force of the Commission's general rule; they may continue until the Commission decides.
obligations.applies_from: 12 months from entry into force of the Commission's general rule

evidence.quote: deberán dar cumplimiento a la obligación de solicitar su registro y autorización para operar ante la Comisión

obligations.summary: Entities that do not apply for registration within the twelve-month period, or do not obtain it, must stop providing services for new operations, conclude existing ones, and notify their clients.
obligations.applies_from: 12 months from entry into force of the Commission's general rule
obligations.conditional_on: Failure to apply or obtain registration within the period

evidence.quote: deberán abstenerse de continuar prestando sus servicios para la celebración de nuevas operaciones

obligations.summary: The Commission must issue the regulation needed to implement the Open Finance System within eighteen months of publication of the law.

evidence.quote: La Comisión para el Mercado Financiero deberá dictar la normativa necesaria para la implementación del Sistema de Finanzas Abiertas

obligations.summary: Entities already providing payment initiation services with client consent when the law enters into force must apply for registration with the Commission, under the CMF general rules, within twelve months from the entry into force of 'estas disposiciones' (most naturally those CMF rules); they may continue until the Commission decides.
obligations.applies_from: 12 months from entry into force of 'estas disposiciones' (the CMF general rules on registration, on the most natural reading)
obligations.conditional_on: Services already provided with client consent at entry into force

evidence.quote: deberán dar cumplimiento a la obligación de solicitar su registro ante la Comisión

obligations.summary: During the first five years, the Ministry of Finance must produce an annual report on the law's effects, including registered entities statistics and Open Finance System data, and send it to the Senate and Chamber finance committees before 31 March of the following year.
obligations.applies_from: First five years from entry into force

evidence.quote: el Ministerio de Hacienda deberá elaborar un informe anual sobre los efectos de la aplicación de la misma

obligations.summary: As inserted into Ley 20.009 Art. 5, where a payment initiation service provider is responsible for an unauthorised payment or transfer, it must reimburse the card or account issuer for its losses or the sums refunded to the user, including the amount of the unauthorised operation.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force of the law (30 days after publication)
obligations.conditional_on: Unauthorised electronic payment initiated through a payment initiation service provider that is responsible for it

evidence.provision: Artículo 38 n°2 (inserting Ley 20.009, Art. 5, inciso séptimo)
evidence.quote: éste deberá resarcir al emisor por las pérdidas sufridas o las sumas abonadas para efectuar la devolución al usuario

enforcement.triggered_by: Infracciones graves listed in Art. 14, or carrying on activities other than those regulated, or regulated activities not authorised under Art. 7
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Cancellation of registration; the text states no fine amount
enforcement.penalty_formula: Cancellation is accessory to the sanction for the underlying conduct; also cancellation for failure to request authorisation within twelve months of registration

evidence.quote: La Comisión podrá cancelar la inscripción en el Registro de todo quien hubiere sido sancionado por las infracciones graves a que se refiere el artículo 14

enforcement.triggered_by: Crimes in Código Penal arts. 467 to 473 committed while subject to CMF supervision and in connection with services regulated by this law; impersonating a registered or supervised entity; crimes under Ley 21.459 against a regulated provider
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Penalty aggravated by one degree; the text states no penalty amount
enforcement.penalty_formula: Aggravating circumstance; penalty increased one degree in the impersonation case and for Ley 21.459 offences against a regulated provider
enforcement.penalty_reference: Código Penal arts. 467 a 473; ley N° 21.459

evidence.quote: Se considerará como circunstancia agravante en los delitos contemplados en los artículos 467 a 473 del Código Penal

enforcement.triggered_by: Infringements of this law or norms issued under it, or failure to comply with lawful CMF instructions or orders, by institutions participating in the Open Finance System
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Sanctions under the sanction regime of Título III of DL 3.538; the text states no amount
enforcement.penalty_formula: Not stated in this text; decisions may be challenged under Título V of DL 3.538
enforcement.penalty_reference: decreto ley N° 3.538, de 1980, título III

evidence.quote: podrán ser sancionadas conforme a las reglas establecidas en el título III del decreto ley N° 3.538, de 1980

enforcement.triggered_by: Non-compliance with this law or its norms, or failure to follow CMF instructions, where necessary to protect Clients or the functioning of the Open Finance System
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Partial or total, temporary or definitive suspension of one or more participating institutions for information exchange; no amount

evidence.quote: la Comisión podrá ordenar la suspensión parcial o total, temporal o definitiva, de una o más instituciones participantes

enforcement.triggered_by: Registered entity that fails to meet requirements for an activity, or a preventive measure needed for investor protection, public faith or financial stability
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Suspension of authorisation for any regulated activity by reasoned resolution; no amount
enforcement.penalty_formula: Not applicable (non-monetary measure); penal and administrative sanctions apply in addition

evidence.quote: podrá suspender la autorización para realizar cualesquiera de las actividades reguladas por la presente ley

enforcement.triggered_by: Proveedores de Servicios basados en Información that no longer meet legal requirements, or preventive measure needed to protect Clients
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Suspension of authorisation to query information under the Open Finance System; no amount
enforcement.penalty_formula: Not applicable (non-monetary measure); penal and administrative sanctions apply in addition

evidence.quote: podrá suspender la autorización para realizar consultas de información bajo el Sistema de Finanzas Abiertas

enforcement.triggered_by: Minimum-capital deficit of an intermediary or custodian not cured within six months: forced cessation of intermediation and custody, with a termination programme, and possible appointment of an interventor
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Forced cessation of services and appointment of one or more interventores; no amount
enforcement.cure_period: Regularisation plan within five calendar days, extendable to ten; six months to cure the deficit

evidence.quote: la entidad deberá dejar de prestar el servicio de intermediación de instrumentos financieros y custodia de instrumentos financieros

enforcement.authority: Superintendencia (as written; the text does not define it)
enforcement.triggered_by: Stock exchange whose minimum capital is not restored within three months of a reduction
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Revocation of the exchange's authorisation of existence, unless the Superintendencia authorises a capital reduction; no amount
enforcement.cure_period: Three months to remedy the deficits

evidence.quote: podrá serle revocada su autorización de existencia por la Superintendencia, a menos que este organismo le autorice la reducción de su capital social

enforcement.triggered_by: Corredor de productos that incurs one of the listed causales, including unremedied deficiencies, serious breaches, or market manipulation
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Suspension for up to one year, or cancellation of registration, by reasoned resolution after a hearing of the affected party; no amount
enforcement.cure_period: Six months to cure deficiencies in the requirement of art. 7 a); up to 180 business days more in qualified cases

evidence.quote: podrá suspender hasta por el plazo máximo de un año o cancelar la inscripción de un corredor en el Registro de Corredores

enforcement.triggered_by: Legal persons sanctioned with cancellation of registration for serious infringements within the previous ten years, or whose principal partners, directors or administrators were sanctioned for such conduct
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Bar on registration; the text states no amount

evidence.quote: No procederá la inscripción de las personas jurídicas que, en los diez años anteriores a la fecha de la solicitud, hubieren sido sancionadas con la cancelación de la inscripción

enforcement.triggered_by: Providers of data-based services or payment initiation who committed very serious and repeated breaches of personal data obligations within twenty-four months (defined in Art. noveno transitorio)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Bar on registration in, and voluntary participation in, the Open Finance System; the text states no amount
enforcement.penalty_reference: Art. noveno transitorio (definition of infracciones gravísimas); ley N° 19.628

evidence.quote: No podrán inscribirse en el Registro de Proveedores de Servicios basados en Información ni participar voluntariamente como Proveedores de Servicios basados en Información

enforcement.authority: Not stated; liability owed to Clients
enforcement.triggered_by: Unauthorised alteration, destruction, loss, processing, disclosure or access to Client data by data-based service providers, or payment initiation providers
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Duty to respond to Clients (liability); the text states no amount

evidence.quote: y responder ante los Clientes en caso de alteración, destrucción, pérdida, tratamiento o comunicación o acceso no autorizado a datos de los Clientes
